blocks.tamil_translation: rights (87)the One who will gather the creation together on the Day of Qiyamah (88)the One free of every need from anyone (89)the One who makes His servants free of need by His grace (90)the One who withholds (91)the One who brings about hardships (according to His wise will) (92)the One who gives benefit (93)the Radiant, the Giver of light (94) the One who shows the right path and leads upon it (95)the One who creates without precedent (96)the One who remains forever without any perishing (97)the One who endures after all have perished (98)the One whose every action and decree is perfectly ordered, the One of subtle wisdom (99)the One full of patience (who, even on seeing His servants commit major sins, does not immediately send punishment and destroy them)

blocks.text:
Explanation:- Many names of Allah are mentioned in the Qur'an and Hadith. Of them, 99 names are mentioned in this hadith.
(Mazahir-ul-Haq)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُبَيِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ﵁ أَنَّ الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالُوا لِلنَّبِيِّ ﷺ: يَامُحَمَّدُ! أُنْسُبْ لَنَا رَبَّكَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَي (قُلْ هُوَاللهُ أَحَدٌ۞ اللهُ الصَّمَدُ۞ لَمْ يَلِدْ لا وَلَمْ يُولَدْ۞ وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ كُفُواً أَحَدٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: “Once the mushriks (those who associate partners with Allah) said to the Prophet ﷺ, “O Muhammad ﷺ, describe to us the lineage of your Lord!’ (In reply to that) Allah Ta'ala revealed Surah Al-Ikhlas: “O Prophet! Say: He (Allah Ta'ala) is One. Allah Ta'ala is free of need (of anyone). He has not begotten (anyone). Nor has He been begotten (by anyone. There is none equal to Him!” Hazrat Ubayy ibn Ka'b (RA) narrates.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: قَالَ اللهُ : كَذَّبَنِي
